$Comment: The server-wide word on what a character shows a player about their quests, and how a tracked quest is pointed at. Each situation group is one situation: Collect (a finished quest whose reward is collected here), TurnIn (handing over what the player carries would finish it), Available (not started, could be taken now), InProgress (being carried, this character is part of it). When several apply to one player at one character the earlier group wins. Every leaf is optional: Enabled switches a situation off outright, State names the look file under Server/ZiggfreedCommon/OverheadIndicators/ (unauthored takes Quest_Reward_Ready, Quest_Ready_To_Turn_In, Quest_Available, Quest_In_Progress), Repeatable.State names the look shown instead when the quest repeats (on any repeat rule: daily, weekly, once a season or sooner), Overhead.Enabled says whether a marker floats over the character, Map.Enabled whether the world map and compass mark them, Map.Icon which marker texture. Overhead is on for a reward to collect, an errand to hand in and a quest on offer, and off for a quest merely in progress (InProgress.Overhead.Enabled false: a character shows nothing for it and any higher situation still shows; set it true to float the in-progress look); a quest on offer that repeats floats Quest_Available_Repeatable; the map marks only what is on offer, since a tracked quest is already pointed at. Pointer.Icon is that pointer's marker texture: every tracked quest gets one, on the character its current step sends the player to, or on the nearest known way into the world that character stands in. A quest narrows the situations from its own Indicator block, a step from its own, and a server owner from mods/ziggfreedcommon/quest-indicators.json under the key Default, each leaf by leaf.
